stories.title: Critical NASA AIT-GUI Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Issue Spacecraft Commands
stories.description: A critical vulnerability in NASA and JPL’s open-source AMMOS Instrument Toolkit (AIT) ground data system framework allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary spacecraft and instrument commands.

stories.title: Hackers Target Zimbra Servers in Active Exploitation Campaign
stories.description: Exploitation of the Zimbra Collaboration vulnerability CVE-2026-73570 has been observed by Poland’s CERT Polska.

stories.title: New Cryptographic Context Injection Attack Could Let Web Pages Steal Grok Chat Data
stories.description: Adversa says encrypted prompt injection can make Grok send a user's name, location, tier, and chat prompts to an attacker-controlled server.

stories.title: Surveillance – Everything You Wanted to Know, But Were Afraid to Ask
stories.description: We all know they’re watching us. But we don’t know who they are, nor why nor how they are doing it.

stories.title: ToxicPanda Android Malware Can Steal Banking PINs and Gain Shell Access to Phones
stories.description: ToxicPanda 2.0 targets 140+ banking apps, steals PINs, overlays screens, and uses 167 commands to control Android devices.

stories.title: Isolated-vm Flaw Lets Sandboxed JavaScript Escape to Host for Potential RCE
stories.description: Isolated-vm's ExternalCopy type confusion lets sandboxed code corrupt host memory and potentially reach host RCE; fixes are in 6.2.0 and 7.0.1.

stories.title: Hackers Use Fake CAPTCHA to Install Malware That Kills 145 Security Processes
stories.description: Fake CAPTCHA pages trick victims into running PowerShell, delivering malware that disables security tools and steals data.

stories.title: Critical NetScaler Flaw Can Bypass Authentication on Certain Gateway and AAA Servers
stories.description: Citrix fixes NetScaler CVE-2026-19490, a CVSS 9.3 authentication bypass affecting certain Gateway, AAA, and SAML configurations.

stories.title: Attackers Exploit Zimbra SNMP Flaw for Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
stories.description: Attackers exploit CVE-2026-73570 on Zimbra servers with zimbra-snmp installed and SNMP notifications enabled, allowing unauthenticated RCE.

stories.title: New Android Malware Steals Banking PINs and Relays Data Through Someone Else’s Infected Phones
stories.description: A newly discovered Android malware family named Manic is bridging the gap between automated financial fraud and persistent mobile espionage.

stories.title: Threat Actor Hacks 14,000 IP Cameras in Ukraine and Russia
stories.description: Operation CameraSwarm targeted Dahua cameras across multiple countries, focusing on Russian and CIS telecom netblocks.
